why.label: WHY DIGITAL SIGNAGE
why.title: Your Screens Should Do More Than Just Display Content.
why.description: When screens, content and locations are managed separately, keeping information accurate and up to date becomes harder as your organization grows.

after.title: Connected & Managed
after.description: Content managed centrally and delivered where it needs to go.

before.title: Same Content Everywhere
before.description: Every screen shows the same thing.

after.title: Right Content, Right Place
after.description: Different content for different audiences, locations and times.

before.title: Difficult to Monitor
before.description: You do not always know what is playing or whether a screen is operating correctly.

after.title: Visible & Manageable
after.description: See what should be playing, where it should be playing and how your screen network is operating.

solution.label: THE SOLUTION
solution.title: One Connected Digital Signage System.
solution.description: Thunder brings together displays, content management, connectivity and ongoing operation into a solution designed for your environment.
solution.caption: FROM CONTENT TO IMPACT. EVERYWHERE.

thunderone.label: CONNECTED BY THUNDERONE
thunderone.title: From Screens to a Managed Media Network.
thunderone.description: ThunderOne Media connects content, screens, channels and operations so your team can manage digital communication as one connected system.

useCases.label: USE CASES
useCases.title: One Platform. Many Ways to Communicate.
useCases.description: Digital Signage can support different communication needs across your organization, customers and physical spaces.
useCases.cta: Talk to Us About Your Use Case

designedForSpace.label: DESIGNED FOR YOUR SPACE

designedForSpace.description: The right digital signage system depends on more than screen size. We consider the space, audience, content, operating environment and how your team will manage it over time.
